_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows Jules reminder details and account state in a compact card.

description: Update a reminder on the connected Jules account.

callWindowMinutes.description: Optional new call lead time in minutes.

recurrenceDays.description: Weekday numbers for custom recurrence, Sunday = 0 through Saturday = 6.

reminderId.description: The Jules reminder ID to update.

scheduledAt.description: Optional new reminder time as an ISO datetime string. Only use this after the user has provided or confirmed an exact time.

timeExpression.description: Required when changing the reminder time. Preserve the user's exact time wording, such as '4:00 PM'.

name: update_jules_reminder
title: Update a Jules reminder
